owner_text: Raimund Teague at Golden Crumb Bakery. Operations manager, if the title matters.
Ignore that, the van wash has broken again.
I'll attach the dispatch procedure, it's easiest.
We move parcels and pallets for other businesses.
Our planner says three sites, mind, counting the cross-dock.
Two. The cross-dock is rented space only.
Never mind me, my daughter's recital is tonight and I'll be leaving early.
Bookings arrive by phone, email, the customer portal and driver app messages. About 180 a day, three minutes to handle and two to key in.
Wrong addresses, missed pickup windows, chasing proof of delivery. Wrong drop-offs, late runs, pickups nobody does.
We want booking intake, driver assignment and proof of delivery chasing handled for us, so we can grow.
The tracking app has an API, the spreadsheet saves CSV. We keep recipient names, delivery addresses and signatures. Rush parcels the same day and medical deliveries are urgent.
Around 25000 USD. When we start, no idea.
